column1: # note: regenerated with the current binaries and pipeline-driver defaults

# note: families = the DEFAULT de novo families: the driver's families stage (mcl_families --from-gtf --min-exonic-bp 1 --min-shared-exon-frac 0.60 --emit-units, MCL 2.8) on the chr16 restriction of the genome-wide A119b assembly (loci seeded with secondary alignments within 2% of the read's best score); one copy per member locus = its representative transcript; copies mapped to genes by span (score.py pairs): 353 copies, 88 families, largest 22 genes; single-exon copies 95/353
# note: precision over JUDGEABLE pairs only: pairs whose two genes both have Compara data (an upper bound)

# note: edge rows: aligned representative pairs above the tier's floor, in bands of the tier's own nucleotide identity (T1 asm20, T2 asm20 -k11 -w5), 'all' = pooled; k = round(precision x n) from spectrum.tsv

# note: family rows: within-family gene pairs of the default families (score.py pairs); multi_exon = pairs of copies with n_exon >= 2; families_with_pairs = families holding >= 1 judged pair; largest_family = the one holding the most judged pairs (family id + its gene-name group); k/n_without_largest = the judged pairs left when that family is removed
# note: ci = Wilson 95% (treats pairs as independent; they are not)
